newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India sells Cochin naphtha to Vitol at - $19.08/T.
newsitem.headline: India sells Cochin naphtha to Vitol at - $19.08/T.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has sold by tender 30,000 tonnes of high aromatic naphtha (HAN) lifting April 1-3 from Cochin on the west coast to Dutch trader Vitol at $19.08 per tonne below Japanese spot quotes, industry sources said on Monday.
The tender which closed March 20 and was valid for a day, sought bids on a free-on-board (fob) basis.
IOC's last HAN cargo from Cochin which lifted March 1-3 was awarded at a $16.50 per tonne discount to Japanese spot quotes, fob.
